programme.title: Cine
programme.desc: Estudio crítico de la historia del cine basado en el libro homónimo. Comparada a las "Histoire(s) du Cinema" de Jean Luc Godard, Cousins aborda visualmente la historia del cine desde su creación hasta nuestros días a través de 15 episodios y cientos de fragmentos cinematográficos desde la creación del cine hasta el último "blockbuster" norteamericano. En ellos encontramos decenas de entrevistas con los principales maestros de nuestro tiempo. Un documental producido por Film 4 para Gran Bretaña. Ha sido emitido con éxito en Reino Unido a través de Channel 4, y fue estrenado íntegro en el Festival de Toronto, además de haber sido proyectado en el MoMA de Nueva York. ★ 7.7/10

Se trata de una superposición de gags que tienen como eje principal una cámara oculta insertada en la máquina dispensadora de café, en la sala donde los trabajadores de la oficina realizan un descanso.Dirigido por Luis Guridi, "Cámera café" cuenta con un elenco de 17 actores, quienes realizan sus estereotipados y extravagantes personajes, entre los que destacan Arturo Valls, Luis Varela, Carlos Chamarro, Alex O'Dogherty y Esperanza Pedreño, entre otros.

programme.title: Genios salvajes de África
programme.desc: En los inhóspitos parajes de África, sobrevivir requiere ingenio. En el desierto, las suricatas entrenan a sus crías para cazar, mientras las arañas rueda recorren las dunas rodando en busca de presas.

programme.title: Mara: el renacer de la Sabana
programme.desc: Después de que la Gran Migración de ñus atraviese la reserva de Masái Mara, la vida continúa para los miles de animales que allí habitan. De julio a octubre, mientras los ñus atraviesan la sabana, la fauna residente busca refugio en sus territorios, a salvo del frenesí. Ya sin ñus en el Mara, vemos cómo estos extraordinarios animales siguen con sus vidas hasta el siguiente mes de julio.

programme.title: Mara: el renacer de la Sabana
programme.desc: Con la llegada de las lluvias, el tranquilo Mara se transforma. Los ríos se desbordan, anegan las llanuras y lo que era un paraíso se convierte en una auténtica amenaza. Cuando por fin despeja el cielo, descubrimos a una madre serval que logró resistir al diluvio... aunque su madriguera no corrió la misma suerte. Contra todo pronóstico, su cachorro también ha sobrevivido: un auténtico milagro dadas las circunstancias.

programme.title: Critter fixers: Veterinarios rurales

A su ajetreado día se suman un dragón barbudo con un bulto, un perro con algunas protuberancias, un conejillo de Indias que lleva piedras y un hurón que lidia con unas hormonas desbocadas.

Brenda examina a un caballo castrado que muestra síntomas de una afección neurológica. Los doctores de PVS también tratan a cachorros de perro de montaña de los Pirineos, a unos peludos gatitos de un refugio, a unos cachorros de pastor alemán y a un Rottweiler de 75 kilos con lesiones en la pata.

programme.title: El increíble doctor Pol
programme.desc: Los veterinarios responden a múltiples emergencias; de un caballo gravemente traumatizado en un accidente a un dulce perrito que quedó con una herida muy grave en el ojo después de una pelea. El Dr. Pol trata a un caballo de carreras con una lesión en el casco que amenaza su carrera, mientras que los Dres. Nicole y Brenda traen la clínica a cuestas. Un reno toro tiene una cornamenta gravemente lacerada e incluso hay una gallina de Guinea que necesita la ayuda del Dr. Pol.

programme.title: Barcos perdidos de la Segunda Guerra Mundial
programme.desc: Los hechos sucedidos a bordo del USS Juneau inspiraron la película 'Salvar al soldado Ryan'. Perdieron la vida cinco hermanos, pero no todos ellos lo hicieron cuando el buque se hundió. Al menos uno de ellos se encontraba entre el puñado de hombres que estuvieron abandonados a su suerte en mitad del mar durante 8 horribles días.

programme.title: Barcos perdidos de la Segunda Guerra Mundial
programme.desc: El equipo del Petrel busca al portaaviones estadounidense USS Hornet. La incursión Doolittle se desarrolló desde su cubierta como venganza por lo sucedido en Pearl Harbor. Sin embargo, seis meses después, el portaaviones es hundido tras encontrarse de pleno con un avispero de buques japoneses.

programme.title: Barcos perdidos de la Segunda Guerra Mundial
programme.desc: Tan solo unas semanas antes del fin de la Segunda Guerra Mundial, el USS Indianapolis es hundido violentamente. Novecientos hombres se encuentran en mitad del mar pero nadie les está buscando. Durante cinco días luchan contra el peligro y los ataques de tiburones. Estamos ante el peor desastre de la historia de la Marina estadounidense.

programme.title: Ciencia para aficionados
programme.desc: Dallas Campbell conduce este programa donde se combinan la seriedad de la ciencia con algunos de los vídeos más locos y espectaculares jamás grabados por los telespectadores. En este episodio aprenderemos los principios científicos aplicables cuando fracasamos al remar en una embarcación, construir un columpio en un árbol e intentar dar una voltereta practicando esquí acuático descalzos.

programme.title: Supercoches a medida
programme.desc: Shane Lynch y Dan Barruffo se embarcan en la misión de crear un Jaguar de carreras de aceleración que pueda homenajear a uno de los aviones más célebres de todos los tiempos: el Supermarine Spitfire. Con un cliente de alto nivel en California, un proyecto que necesita un resultado perfecto y una de las fechas de entrega más ajustadas, los chicos se ven obligados a desafiar al jefe y crear el vehículo en Méjico.

programme.title: Supercoches a medida
programme.desc: En este episodio los mecánicos expertos Ralph y Ranen van a intentar cumplir el sueño de su jefe, Afzal Kahn: fabricar uno de los coches de carretera más rápidos del mundo. Afzal es un emprendedor del mundo del motor que quiere dar más impulso a su imperio, y para eso ha pedido a sus técnicos, Ralph y Ranen, un coche que sea más rápido que el Bugatti Veyron.

programme.title: Las reparaciones más difíciles del mundo
programme.desc: Acompañamos a Riley en un viaje a Las Vegas para ayudar al Cirque du Soleil a solucionar un problema que le está estropeando el espectáculo. La parte central de su show es el escenario más grande y más avanzado tecnológicamente del mundo, pero está fallando.

programme.title: Las reparaciones más difíciles del mundo
programme.desc: Agárrate fuerte y pase lo que pase, no mires hacia abajo.

programme.title: La ciencia del desastre
programme.desc: Tres desastres reales que someteremos a un examen forense y recrearemos en sorprendente detalle gracias a los análisis de expertos y a todas las pruebas. ¿Por qué el se fusionaron varios núcleos de la planta nuclear de Fukushima y se produjeron explosiones tras un gran terremoto?¿Cómo se desplomó sobre Manhattan una grúa de 60 metros de altura? ¿Por qué el USS Forrestal, un portaaviones con bandera estadounidense, explotó matando a 134 miembros de su tripulación?

programme.title: Tras el desastre
programme.desc: Tras el desastre: Desde accidentes que llenaron titulares hasta buques naufragados que fueron olvidados: el océano se ha llevado incontables vidas. Errores humanos, tormentas, eventos imprevistos, fallos técnicos e incluso simplemente la mala suerte, pueden convertir viajes de larga distancia en auténticas tragedias. A pesar de los siglos de progreso y de los avances en tecnología, el mar sigue siendo un enclave indomable. Desde la desaparición del Titán hasta el hundimiento del Lusitania, hablaremos sobre los 10 peores desastres acaecidos en el mar.

programme.title: Drenar los océanos: a fondo
programme.desc: Únase a los arqueólogos en su búsqueda de los restos del desaparecido Kad'yak, un barco mercante con casco de madera de 200 años de antigüedad. Los expertos reconstruyen la imagen del barco para revelar su carga y trazar el épico viaje de su desaparición. En Groenlandia, los científicos se adentran bajo el hielo para entrar en Camp Century, la famosa y clasificada base militar construida en 1959.

programme.title: Drenar los océanos: a fondo
programme.desc: Bajo las turbias aguas de los ríos de Estados Unidos se esconde un mundo olvidado de barcos hundidos e historia oculta. Desde buques mercantes hasta barcos de vapor de la Guerra Civil, estas vías fluviales cuentan la historia del crecimiento de una nación: impulsaron la expansión hacia el Oeste, sirvieron de motor a la industria e incluso sirvieron de rutas secretas para el contrabando durante la Ley Seca. Cada río encierra una historia de ambición, ingenio y misterio que espera ser recuperada.

programme.title: Tesoros perdidos de La Biblia: Misterios de la Fe
programme.desc: Para millones de personas, Jesús es tanto el Hijo de Dios como una figura histórica real. Pero ¿qué pruebas arqueológicas existen sobre las personas y los lugares que marcaron su vida? La investigación comienza en la Iglesia del Santo Sepulcro de Jerusalén, que se dice que fue construida sobre el lugar donde fue enterrado Jesús. Pero hay un enigma: en el siglo I d. C., los entierros solo se realizaban fuera de las murallas de la ciudad, pero la iglesia se encuentra dentro de la Ciudad Vieja. ¿Podrán los expertos resolver el misterio? En otra parte de Jerusalén, los arqueólogos buscan el lugar donde se dice que Jesús realizó la curación milagrosa de un ciego, la piscina de Siloé, y buscan pistas sobre los acontecimientos de sus últimos días, incluida la Última Cena. Más allá de Jerusalén, los investigadores buscan la ciudad perdida de Betsaida, lugar donde se alimentó a cinco mil personas y hogar de tres de sus discípulos.

programme.title: Segunda Guerra Mundial: Infierno bajo el mar
programme.desc: Junio de 1945. Con el paso de mercantes japoneses reducido al mínimo, el comandante Eugene Fluckey, galardonado con una Medalla de Honor del ejército estadounidense, apuesta con un miembro de la tripulación a que son capaces de hundir quince buques durante su patrulla de guerra. Además, planea destruir distintos objetivos de la costa de Japón. Durante esta campaña de acoso surgen tácticas sin precedentes, como la de llevar a tierra a un pequeño grupo de saboteadores para hacer saltar por los aires un tren japonés.

programme.title: Segunda Guerra Mundial: Infierno bajo el mar
programme.desc: Octubre de 1962. Una misión secreta envía cuatro submarinos Proyecto soviéticos que transportan torpedos nucleares a toda prisa hacia Cuba. Durante dicha ruta, EE UU despliega un cerco de cuarentena alrededor de la isla. Cuando el submarino soviético B-59 es descubierto, se utilizan "cargas de profundidad"; casi provocando una guerra mundial.

programme.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas
programme.desc: En plena epidemia de COVID-19, el vuelo 1344 de Air India Express repatría a ciudadanos indios desde Dubái y se encuentra en la aproximación final al aeropuerto de Calicut en medio de fuertes lluvias, visibilidad reducida y vientos fuertes. La traicionera pista de aterrizaje no deja margen para el error. Tras un primer intento fallido, el Boeing 737-800 toma tierra, pero no consigue detenerse y se precipita por un barranco. El avión se rompe con el impacto, causando la muerte de 21 personas, incluidos los dos pilotos. Al principio, los investigadores sospechan que se trata de un problema con el sistema de frenado. Pero pronto descubren un fallo impactante de naturaleza completamente diferente. Por alguna razón, el avión entró por encima de la senda de planeo, sobrepasó la zona de aterrizaje y se salió de la pista. Y la causa fatal queda registrada en la grabación de voz de la cabina.

programme.title: Mayday: catástrofes aéreas
programme.desc: Un fallo inexplicable provoca la pérdida de los dos motores de un avión de pasajeros recién estrenado que vuela de Montreal a Edmonton.

programme.title: Arqueología de la muerte
programme.desc: Cuando se hallan los restos humanos de una mujer cerca de Velje, en Dinamarca, un arqueólogo comienza a dar detalles sobre la fantástica historia de su identidad y del motivo por el que fue asesinada, vinculándola con antiguas estirpes.

programme.title: Arqueología de la muerte
programme.desc: Cerca de Silkeborg, en Dinamarca, un grupo de personas que extraían turba descubre una cabeza humana y las autoridades rápidamente comienzan a trabajar en su identificación, ya que puede tratarse de un chico desaparecido en la zona. No obstante, un sagaz oficial de policía revela que el cuerpo es mucho más antiguo que la persona desaparecida que están buscando y llama al museo para que realice una investigación.

programme.title: Historia Singular
programme.desc: ¿Cómo las personas más adineradas de la historia acumularon su riqueza? ¿en qué la invirtieron? y realmente ¿el dinero compró su felicidad?

programme.title: Historia Singular
programme.desc: Investigaremos las muchas revoluciones que se han producido en la historia, de índole industrial, sexual y la mayor de todas: la revolución política.

programme.title: Expedientes misterio de la Antigüedad
programme.desc: Guillermo de Anda, arqueólogo submarino, sigue un rastro de pistas que lo guían por Méjico y Guatemala en busca del averno de los mayas, el Xibalba. Mientras investiga mitos antiguos y estudia los últimos descubrimientos arqueológicos, Anda encuentra huesos en cuevas submarinas, pruebas de la existencia de sacrificios humanos rituales, y leyendas sobre un terrible viaje. Finalmente se prepara para hacer una última inmersión en una cueva mejicana que podría ser la mismísima entrada a Xibalba.

programme.title: Tesoros perdidos de La Biblia: Misterios de la Fe
programme.desc: Para millones de personas, Jesús es tanto el Hijo de Dios como una figura histórica real. La investigación comienza en la Iglesia del Santo Sepulcro de Jerusalén, que se dice que fue construida sobre el lugar donde fue enterrado Jesús. Pero hay un enigma: en el siglo I d. En otra parte de Jerusalén, los arqueólogos buscan el lugar donde se dice que Jesús realizó la curación milagrosa de un ciego, la piscina de Siloé, y buscan pistas sobre los acontecimientos de sus últimos días, incluida la Última Cena. programme.title: Tesoros perdidos de La Biblia: Misterios de la Fe
programme.desc: En Israel, los arqueólogos investigan la verdad que se esconde tras uno de los mayores descubrimientos de la historia: los Rollos del Mar Muerto. Hallados en 1947 en lo profundo del desierto de Judea, este extraordinario hallazgo de manuscritos de 2000 años de antigüedad incluye las copias más antiguas de los textos bíblicos jamás encontradas. Pero nadie sabe quién los escribió ni por qué fueron ocultados. En este episodio, los investigadores combinan las excavaciones tradicionales con tecnologías analíticas revolucionarias para descubrir nuevas pruebas que podrían ayudar a resolver estos misterios. Las técnicas de imagen de última generación revelan pistas ocultas en los manuscritos, que podrían ayudar a identificar a los autores, mientras que los descubrimientos arqueológicos en Jerusalén dibujan un panorama de un acontecimiento brutal y destructivo que destrozó el antiguo mundo judío en la época en que se ocultaron los manuscritos.

programme.title: Los secretos de Nínive y Babilonia
programme.desc: Nínive y Babilonia eran dos superpotencias del Mundo Antiguo, pero para los escritores de la Biblia eran ciudades de pecado. En Nínive, los arqueólogos están uniendo las piezas de las maravillas perdidas destruidas por el Estado Islámico. En Babilonia, los especialistas restauran la Puerta de Ishtar, construida por un infame tirano bíblico. ¿Por qué se describen de una forma tan negativa estos lugares en el Antiguo Testamento? y ¿cómo eran en realidad esas ciudades?

programme.desc: Cole ha descubierto que en casa de las Halliwell hay un camaleón: un demonio con capacidad de transformarse en un objeto que ha sido enviado por La Fuente para espiar a Las Embrujadas. Las hermanas deben encontrar al demonio para que La Fuente no pueda llevar a cabo el plan trazado con la información que ha obtenido. En lugar de eso, Piper se marcha a una fiesta de bebés. Mientras estén separadas, todas son vulnerables. Los puntos débiles de Piper son sus ganas de tener un hijo y de renunciar a su destino como bruja.

programme.title: Embrujadas
programme.desc: Al terminar una pelea y casi sin venir a cuento, Cole le pide a Phoebe que se case con él. Ella evita el tema centrándose en buscar a un peligroso demonio, uno que ataca exactamente igual que Balthazor. A medida que avanza la investigación, descubrirán que el nuevo demonio y el novio de Phoebe tienen muchas cosas en común. Tantas, que pueden llegar a ser confundidos.

programme.title: Embrujadas
programme.desc: Cole está preocupado porque, ahora que La Fuente ha sido derrotada, sabe que se producirá una guerra por el poder en el Inframundo, pero a Phoebe le preocupa más celebrar que su novio ha perdido sus poderes. Cuando las Musas empiezan a desaparecer, las Embrujadas se dan cuenta de que Cole tenía razón y descubren que una facción se ha apoderado del Anillo de la Inspiración.

programme.desc: 1982. El joven Brenner, un auténtico as de los videojuegos, participa en el primer Campeonato Mundial de Máquinas Recreativas. La NASA pretende grabar en vídeo la competición e incluirla en una recopilación de noticias y de cultura popular que será lanzada al espacio en una sonda para intentar contactar con formas de vida extraterrestre. Todos los icónicos juegos arcade de los salones recreativos de la década de 1980 ("Galaxian", "Frogger", "Donkey Kong", "Space Invaders", "Pac-Man", "Asteroids", "Arkanoid", "Defender"...) se unen en "Pixels", comedia de ciencia ficción que cuenta con Adam Sandler como productor y principal protagonista. programme.title: El Gato con Botas
programme.desc: Mucho antes de que conociera a Shrek, el conocido espadachín, seductor y fuera de la ley Gato con Botas se convierte en un héroe al emprender una aventura junto a la dura y espabilada Kitty Zarpas Suaves y al astuto Humpty Dumpty para salvar a su pueblo. Complicándoles las cosas por el camino están los infames forajidos Jack y Jill, que harán cualquier cosa para que Gato y su banda no lo consigan.Chris Miller dirige esta película, en la que el Gato con Botas de la saga "Shrek" se convierte en protagonista absoluto, de nuevo con la voz de Antonio Banderas, tanto en la versión inglesa como en la española. La actriz mexicana Salma Hayek también repite en las dos versiones poniendo voz a Kitty Zarpas Suaves.

programme.title: Morbius
programme.desc: Tras el propio Hombre Araña y Venom, un nuevo personaje se incorpora al Universo Spider-Man de Sony: el inquietante antihéroe vampírico Morbius, a quien da vida Jared Leto ("La casa Gucci", "Dallas Buyers Club"), un actor que lo tiene muy claro: "me gustan los papeles en los que me puedo transformar física, mental y emocionalmente". Y este es, sin duda, uno de ellos.Michael Morbius, personaje de Marvel Comics creado por el guionista Roy Thomas y el dibujante Gil Kane en 1971, es un científico aquejado de una rara enfermedad sanguínea, un doctor en bioquímica que lleva toda su vida intentando encontrar una cura... y ahora cree haberlo conseguido.

programme.title: It
programme.desc: El director Andy Muschietti ("Mamá") lleva al cine la novela homónima de Stephen King (1986), con Bill Skarsgård como el terrorífico payaso Pennywise.La película cuenta la historia de los 7 niños de 'El club de los perdedores', siempre acosados por los abusones del pueblo de Derry, en el que viven todos. Todos ellos tienen, además, otra cosa en común: han visto sus peores pesadillas hacerse realidad en forma de un antiguo depredador que cambia de forma y al que denominan 'eso'. Desde que existe, Derry ha sido el coto de caza de esa entidad, que resurge de las alcantarillas cada 27 años para alimentarse de los miedos de sus presas favoritas: los niños.Con guion de Gary Dauberman (saga "Annabelle"), Cary Fukunaga (director de la primera temporada de "True Detective") y el debutante en la gran pantalla Chase Palmer, "It" está coprotagonizada, entre otros, por los jóvenes Finn Wolfhard (Mike Wheeler en "Stranger Things") y Jaeden Lieberher (o Martell) ("Puñales por la espalda").

programme.title: Below Deck Adventure
programme.desc: Captain Kerry takes “Below Deck” on its greatest adventure yet – the cold waters of Norway! Faye joins Mercury Yacht Mercury as chief stew with experience from all over the world as a former businesswoman, but when she finds out her team of stews know each other, she worries how their past will serve the interior. Wanderlust chef Jess has a big appetite for adventure, but the remote conditions of Norway limit her provisioning options as she sizes up the storage issues on the boat as well as her new chief stew. When it’s time for Nathan to hand over his anchor-watch duties to deckhand Kyle, tensions rise and Kyle’s cowboy ways leaves Nathan wondering if he will buck up or shut up.

programme.title: Below Deck Adventure
programme.desc: The first adventure of the season sends the charter on a caving expedition, but it’s Kyle who ends up digging himself into a hole by flirting with Kasie in front of guests. When Capt. Communication issues between the stews and the galley continue to mount, putting meal quality in jeopardy and sparking distrust between Jess and Faye. After taking ill on Day 1 of charter, Oriana strives to prove herself worthy to Faye. Nathan clashes with Kyle over life jacket safety and Mike gets a crash course in Charter Yachting 101.

programme.title: Below Deck Adventure
programme.desc: Lewis warns Kyle that his bad behavior has Capt. Kerry on high alert. When the Mercury engines fail, Kerry has to rely on his young deck crew to execute a precarious docking. With their first charter behind them, the crew celebrates with a night on the town, but Kyle parties like there’s no tomorrow. His failure to flush the cabin toilet leads to an altercation with Nathan and lands him in hot water with the captain again. Faye and Jess chalk up the issues between their departments to first-charter jitters. After sizing up her team, Faye doesn’t name a second stew, leaving Oriana anxious and confused about her standing on the boat.

programme.title: Below Deck Adventure
programme.desc: As the Mercury team prepares for their next charter, Capt. Kerry notifies the crew he asked Kyle to resign. Pressures rise for both the interior and exterior team as they are drowning in extra duties. Capt. Kerry lends a helping hand to the short-staffed deck crew by transporting the guests to the boat. These southern belles are single and ready to mingle with the exterior team but start to lose their patience with the interior team as they realize most of their food items can’t be sourced in Norway. Things get too hot in the galley during a stressful breakfast service leaving Jess’s future on the boat up in flames.

programme.title: Below Deck Adventure
programme.desc: After Jess burns herself, Capt. Kerry lends a hand to prepare a five-star picnic for the guests’ excursion. Nathan becomes a standout in service, leading guests on an epic biking adventure down Trollstigen Road by day and serving shirtless by night. As Charter 2 ends, Lewis faces the pressure of being a man down for another charter. Faye is furious when she learns that second stew epaulets have been ordered for Oriana behind her back. A crew night off leads to something steamy in the hot tub.

programme.title: Below Deck Adventure
programme.desc: After a steamy night in the hot tub, Lewis is met with fears of where his relationship with one of the stews will stand in the morning. Faye questions who she can trust after Oriana went over her head to order new epaulets. With elite and demanding charter guests, Faye calls on the already short-handed deck team for assistance and even goes so far as to pull Nathan out of bed, causing a blow up with Mike and Faye. Later, while on anchor watch, an overworked and exhausted Nathan goes to bed before handing the shift over, leaving the boat unattended and a furious Lewis calling him out in front of Capt. Kerry. In the galley, Oriana struggles to keep up with the pace of breakfast, causing Jess to lose her temper with the entire interior. Lewis and Nathan take the guests on an epic adventure ziplining through the jungles of Norway. A misstep leaves the exterior at risk of losing yet another deckhand.

programme.title: Below Deck Adventure
programme.desc: In the aftermath of Nathan’s fall down the stairs, Lewis and Capt. Kerry worry they’ll be down yet another deckhand as they await the arrival of a new crew member. During service, the interior team continues its ongoing battle with the exterior when Mike misses a walkie call to help carry plates to the table. Primary Charter guest Heather Gay and friends request a Fire and Ice theme for their final dinner, prompting Jess to experiment with a dessert she’s never made before leaving her stressed. Communication issues cause problems on deck for Lewis just as his new deckhand – a former captain – arrives and starts assessing the team. Faye sets her sights on the new guy A crew night out in Alesund ends with a one-cabin cuddle party.

programme.title: Below Deck Adventure
programme.desc: With a full crew finally onboard the Mercury, things should be smooth sailing but new deckhand Seth is quick to find cracks within the leadership of his department and vows he could run it better. A Viking Oktoberfest-themed dinner serves up some brat-ty attitudes when a plate mix-up pushes Chef Jess to call out the interior in front of the guests for not reading their preferences. Faye coordinates her most challenging adventure yet by taking the guests paragliding. While there, Faye must rely on the rest of her team to fulfill the other pieces of the adventure itinerary. However, when the plan changes without her permission, Faye reminds everyone why it’s not a good idea to cross her.

programme.title: Below Deck Adventure
programme.desc: Fed up with her crew’s disobedience, Faye orders the team back to the picnic field to fulfill the guests’ request for an afternoon of games. Lewis triumphs with a brilliant obstacle course featuring a gigantic inflatable iceberg, but breaking it down proves to be a comedy of errors for the entire deck team and creates more discord between him and Faye. Seth’s frustrations with his less-experienced bosun mount, leading him to approach Capt. Kerry about replacing Lewis. The crew is rewarded with an adventure of their own, but a day of canyoning is marked with fear, anxiety and a showdown between departments.

programme.title: Below Deck Adventure
programme.desc: Tension between departments leaves Faye fed up as she vows that she’s not going to be the nice chief stew they’ve had all season. Capt. Kerry mentors Lewis in the wheelhouse and suggests to his bosun he consider promoting someone to lead deckhand so he can spend more time working on his career path. Misconduct on the radio upsets the captain and thrusts Lewis back on deck, unable to trust his team to perform the most basic tasks. Frustrations continue to build between bunkmates on the interior, leading Kasie to make a plan with Jess to do a room swap. The deckies take their turn entertaining the guests in drag. On an epic abseiling adventure, Faye reaches her breaking point and cries in front of guests over forgotten chips.

programme.title: Below Deck Adventure
programme.desc: The interior department is on thin ice following the guests finding hair in their food as chips go missing at the abseiling picnic. Faye calls Jess and the stews together in an effort to heal the fractured interior, but her quest to hide the hair issue from Capt. Kerry ends in disaster. Capt. Kerry attempts to outrun bad weather and return the guests safely to port. Kasie teaches Mike how to make a bed as the two get closer. Seth tries to further his relationship with Faye. Jess moves out of Faye’s cabin hoping to ease growing tensions, but things only get worse when they fight over food for the guests’ horseback riding adventure. A promotion in the exterior department rattles the rest of the deckhands.

programme.title: Below Deck Adventure
programme.desc: Tension grows higher as the season gets shorter on Mercury when Faye and Jess disagree on how much food should be packed for the horseback riding adventure. Exhaustion gets to Lead Deckhand Seth, who puts the dynamic of the boat at risk when he’s caught sleeping on the job. The start of the final charter leaves the Mercury crew feeling that an end is in sight, but that ending may come more quickly for some than others as Chef Jess spirals during dinner service and later storms out of the wheelhouse proclaiming this isn’t where she needs to be.

programme.title: Below Deck Adventure
programme.desc: After Kerry calls out her intimidating behavior, Jess makes a decision on whether to leave the Mercury before the end of the season. Seth confronts Kasie over the photo she took of him sleeping in the mess leading to new accusations. Later, two crew members get intimate after everyone goes to bed. The Mercury crew says their last goodbye.

"The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: The Price Is Right

"The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.desc: Each episode of this cooking competition, hosted by Joel McHale, begins at the scene of the crime - a kitchen that was just used to make an amazing, mouthwatering dessert that has since disappeared. programme.title: Open Water
programme.desc: Daniel (Daniel Travis) and Susan (Blanchard Ryan) embark on a tropical vacation with their scuba-diving certifications in tow. During a group dive, the two separate themselves from the others to dive a little deeper. An incorrect head-count suggests the entire group has returned, so the boat departs. When the pair surfaces, they make out a vessel in the distance, but it does not immediately set in that they have been left behind. With sharks lurking beneath, their survival chances grow smaller.

programme.title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding
programme.desc: Everyone in the Portokalos family worries about Toula (Nia Vardalos). Still unmarried at 30 years old, she works at Dancing Zorba's, the Greek restaurant owned by her parents, Gus (Michael Constantine) and Maria (Lainie Kazan). After taking a job at her aunt's travel agency, she falls in love with Ian Miller (John Corbett), a teacher who is tall, handsome and definitely not Greek. Toula isn't sure which will be more upsetting to her father, that Ian is a foreigner or that he's a vegetarian.

programme.title: Ruby Sparks
programme.desc: Young author Calvin Weir-Fields (Paul Dano), once a literary darling, is having trouble composing his next novel. Following a therapist's advice, Calvin pulls out an old manual typewriter and creates a vivacious, flame-haired woman he dubs Ruby Sparks (Zoe Kazan). Overnight, Ruby leaps from the page into Calvin's home as a real flesh-and-blood woman. And, what's more, she's unaware that she's actually a fictional character and that her actions and feelings are dictated by whatever Calvin writes.

programme.title: Shazam!
programme.desc: We all have a superhero inside of us -- it just takes a bit of magic to bring it out. In 14-year-old Billy Batson's case, all he needs to do is shout out one word to transform into the adult superhero Shazam. Still a kid at heart, Shazam revels in the new version of himself by doing what any other teen would do -- have fun while testing out his newfound powers. But he'll need to master them quickly before the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana can get his hands on Shazam's magical abilities.

programme.title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods
programme.desc: Bestowed with the powers of the gods, Billy Batson and his fellow foster kids are still learning how to juggle teenage life with their adult superhero alter egos. When a vengeful trio of ancient gods arrives on Earth in search of the magic stolen from them long ago, Shazam and his allies get thrust into a battle for their superpowers, their lives, and the fate of the world.

programme.title: The Flash
programme.desc: Worlds collide when the Flash uses his superpowers to travel back in time to change the events of the past. However, when his attempt to save his family inadvertently alters the future, he becomes trapped in a reality in which General Zod has returned, threatening annihilation. With no other superheroes to turn to, the Flash looks to coax a very different Batman out of retirement and rescue an imprisoned Kryptonian -- albeit not the one he's looking for.

programme.title: Aquaman and the Lost Kingdom
programme.desc: After failing to defeat Aquaman the first time, Black Manta wields the power of the mythic Black Trident to unleash an ancient and malevolent force. Hoping to end his reign of terror, Aquaman forges an unlikely alliance with his brother, Orm, the former king of Atlantis. Setting aside their differences, they join forces to protect their kingdom and save the world from irreversible destruction.

programme.title: Gifted
programme.desc: Frank Adler (Chris Evans) is a single man raising a child prodigy - his spirited young niece Mary (Mckenna Grace) - in a coastal town in Florida. Frank's plans for a normal school life for Mary are foiled when the 7-year-old's mathematical abilities come to the attention of Frank's formidable mother, Evelyn (Lindsay Duncan), whose plans for her granddaughter threaten to separate Frank and Mary.

programme.title: Valérian et la cité des mille planètes

Mandaté par le ministre de la Défense, le duo part en mission sur l'extraordinaire cité intergalactique Alpha. Un mystère se cache au coeur d'Alpha, une force obscure qui menace l'existence paisible de la Cité des mille planètes. Ils vont devoir engager une course contre la montre pour identifier la terrible menace et sauver Alpha.

programme.title: Voyageurs

La mission sombre dans la folie, l'équipage revenant à son état le plus primitif, sans savoir si la véritable menace à laquelle ils sont confrontés est ce qui se trouve à l'extérieur du vaisseau ou ce qu'ils deviennent à l'intérieur.

Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. Canadian and international comics - up-and-coming talents as well as established artists - come together every July at the festival, including Jeff Foxworthy, Tim Allen, John Cleese, Billy Connolly, Gabriel Iglesias, Ilana Glazer, Andy Samberg, David Spade, Sandra Battaglini, Russell Peters, and Jay Pharoah, all of whom have taken the stage over the festival's decades-long history.

programme.title: The Guild Garage
programme.desc: In a multibillion dollar industry, the Guild of Automotive Restorers tries to get a piece of the pie by completing any task put before it. Through preservation, restoration and selling some of the world's greatest cars, the team at the Guild has gained an internationally acknowledged reputation. Owner David Granger and his crew turn rust into gold, whether a rare vintage Lancia comes in for a complete rebuild or a classic Chevy needs some "go faster" stripes. Through it all, Granger and his crew face shop-floor drama, gas-fueled egos and millions at stake.

programme.title: How It's Made
programme.desc: A look behind the scenes at how everyday things are manufactured. Typically each episode includes three to four products featured, with a mix consisting of common items such as jeans, aluminum foil and cereal, and less predictable ones like wax figurines, braille typewriters and pinball machines.

programme.title: Just for Laughs Gags
programme.desc: The Just for Laughs Festival has been a staple of the Canadian comedy scene for more than 30 years. Now, the festival lends its famous name to this hidden-camera prank show starring a Quebec-based troupe. Canada is the stage and its inhabitants are the characters - some might say victims - for the "Candid Camera"-style pranks featured on the half-hour series. Although the pranks last just a few minutes each, that's just long enough to inflict embarrassment on the subjects of the pranks.

programme.title: Just for Laughs: Gags
programme.desc: There's no sound, but there sure are plenty of laughs. This crazy Quebec-based troupe uses the city as its stage, and its inhabitants, or victims, as characters! People are caught in a twisted yet funny web of comedic deception. This updated "Candid Camera" is a tad more risque and a little kookier with its practical jokes. The little snippets last only a few minutes, and some look more painful than others.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Don't be ridiculous! When it comes to Internet videos run amok, however, the more zany, unbelievable and downright dangerous the clips are, the greater the chance they'll be shown on this series. It features amateur viral videos being critiqued by MTV personality Rob Dyrdek ("Rob Dyrdek's Fantasy Factory"), who knows a thing or two about pushing the envelope from his pro skateboarding days. With commentary from Sterling "Steelo" Brim and Chanel (the rapping receptionist from "Fantasy Factory"), Dyrdek breaks down the clips by putting them in such categories as "Hot Mess," "Worst Case Scenario," "Redneck Good Times" and "What Happened Last Night." It's sure to be seriously ridiculous.

programme.title: Auction Hunters
programme.desc: When storage units are put up for auction, Allen Haff and Clinton Jones speed into action. The business partners have capitalized on what has become a thriving trade amidst a down economy: buying abandoned storage units in hope of finding valuable property inside. This series follows Haff and Jones as they travel from auction to auction, first showing how they determine their bids after getting only a brief look inside the units. Then if they win the auction, the "dig" begins, a process by which they assess every item in the unit before selling the valuable ones in the antique and collectible markets.

He betrays Rio and absconds with the loot, and Rio ends up in prison. Years pass before Rio finally breaks free to enact his long-plotted revenge. Tracking Dad to California, Rio learns he's become a sheriff -- which is no deterrent -- but when Rio falls for Dad's stepdaughter, Louisa (Pina Pellicer), he has second thoughts.

programme.title: Twice Upon a Yesterday

Wishing he could undo his error, Victor happens upon two otherworldly trash collectors, who send him back in time. He uses the opportunity to woo Sylvia again, while making sure that an attractive woman catches Dave's eye. But his attraction to a waitress, Louise, could ruin Victor's plan to right things with Sylvia.

programme.title: Jericho
programme.desc: Jericho (Mark Valley) wakes up with no memory, but it's apparent that he's quite skilled with a gun. He is befriended by Joshua (Leon Coffee), who appears to be his polar opposite: He's a black man and true believer in the Lord, whereas Jericho is white and doubtful of everything, especially himself. Side by side, they attempt to piece together the amnesiac's past, which may or may not have something to do with a robbery, and either way is somehow connected to a town that's also called Jericho.

programme.title: Angel and the Badman
programme.desc: Quirt Evans (John Wayne), a cowboy on the run, is injured when his horse stumbles near a Quaker family's land. The family takes him in as he regains his health, and he falls for their young daughter, Penelope (Gail Russell). As Quirt falls deeper in love and becomes accustomed to the family's peaceful ways, his violent past starts to catch up to him. Eventually he is forced to decide whether it is worth letting go of his turbulent former life for his future with Penelope.

programme.title: Live: The Paul Finebaum Show
programme.desc: Veteran writer, reporter and radio personality Paul Finebaum built a legion of loyal sports fans as the "Voice of the SEC" during 20 years hosting his Birmingham, Ala.-based radio talk show. When ESPN launched the SEC Network in 2014, it was only natural that Finebaum became its first on-air hire, bringing his radio show -- and those passionate followers -- with him. Now originating from one of the SEC Network studios in Charlotte, N.C., the show is a forum for lively discussion and debate of all things SEC and across the spectrum of college sports, with Finebaum playing the role of both moderator and provocateur. The show airs weekday afternoons throughout the year on SEC Network.

programme.title: Live: College Softball
programme.desc: Action from women's college softball.

programme.title: Electra
programme.desc: When King Agamemnon returns from battle, he is slain by his wife, Clytemnestra (Aleka Katselli), and her lover. The king's son, Orestes (Giannis Fertis), is sent into exile, and his daughter, Electra (Irene Papas), into mourning. Over the years, Electra's hatred of her mother grows, and she bristles with the desire for vengeance. When she and Orestes are reunited, the siblings hatch a plot for revenge. But can they reconcile their need for justice with the act of matricide?

programme.title: The Miracle Worker
programme.desc: Blind and deaf after suffering a terrible fever as a baby, young Helen Keller (Patty Duke) has spent years unable to communicate, leaving her frustrated and occasionally violent. As a last chance before she is institutionalized, her parents (Inga Swenson, Andrew Prine) contact a school for the blind, which sends half-blind Annie Sullivan (Anne Bancroft) to teach Helen. Helen is initially resistant, but Annie gradually forms a bond with her and shows Helen ways of reaching others.

programme.title: Love Chronicles
programme.desc: A disc jockey and a therapist help callers on a radio program sort through their relationship issues.

programme.title: Love Is a Ball
programme.desc: Matchmaker Etienne Pimm (Charles Boyer) makes his living by pairing European aristocrats with rich Americans, and his latest match is between Duke Gaspard Ducluzeau (Ricardo Montalban) and affluent heiress Millie Mehaffey (Hope Lange). Unfortunately, Ducluzeau, handsome and titled as he is, needs some help in acting aristocratic. Luckily, John Davis (Glenn Ford) is on hand to teach the Duke how to behave like the high-society man he is, at least until Davis and Mehaffey meet.

programme.title: Adventures of Kitty O'Day
programme.desc: Kitty O'Day (Jean Parker) is a switchboard operator at a busy hotel where her boyfriend, Johnny (Peter Cookson), also works. Suspicious about some strange noises, she sends Johnny to her employer's apartment, where Johnny finds the boss has been murdered. Kitty is determined to find the culprit, but the hotheaded Inspector Clancy (Tim Ryan) is also on the case, and, as more bodies pile up at the hotel, the police start to throw accusations at Kitty and her amateur crime-solving crew.

programme.title: The Group
programme.desc: Eight young women from the Vassar College class of 1933 rush out into the world to find exciting lives, but discover nothing is quite as they dreamed. Rather than blazing trails in art, science and literature, the friends are each variously burdened with disappointing relationships, children, aging parents and unemployment. Kay Strong (Joanna Pettet), the center of the group, gradually loses faith in the promise of their lives and, as war approaches, becomes unhinged.

programme.title: The Hoodlum Priest
programme.desc: Venturing into some of the roughest slums of St. Louis, Jesuit priest Rev. Charles Dismas Clark (Don Murray) dedicates himself to helping young ex-convicts who are struggling to rejoin a society that fears and rejects them. An especially wrenching case for the Reverend is Billy Lee Jackson (Keir Dullea), a troubled thief whose personal demons constantly tempt him back to a life of crime -- and may ultimately make him pay the highest price for a few desperate decisions.

programme.title: House of 1,000 Dolls
programme.desc: A magician (Vincent Price) and his assistant (Martha Hyer) lure women from the audience into white slavery in Tangier.

programme.title: The Large Rope
programme.desc: An innocent ex-con becomes a two-time loser when he finds himself the scapegoat in the murder of a disreputable female.

programme.title: Born Losers
programme.desc: A biker gang incites a reign of terror in a California coastal town that culminates in four teenage girls being raped. Vietnam veteran Billy Jack (Tom Laughlin) has had enough, however, and takes on the depraved bikers single-handedly. He rescues young Vicky Barrington (Elizabeth James) from their clutches, but then has to contend with not only the thugs, but also the ineffectual and racist local lawmen, who have it out for the half-Native American Billy.

programme.title: Rage
programme.desc: A radical militia group considers a California teacher (Gary Daniels) a prime specimen to clone for its army.

programme.title: Kill a Dragon
programme.desc: When a valuable shipment of nitroglycerin washes ashore on an island near Hong Kong, the natives think it's theirs, owing to the law of salvage. However, local mob boss Nico Patrai (Fernando Lamas) thinks otherwise and gives the islanders three days to return it before he starts killing them. Rather than give in, the islanders hire soldier of fortune Rick Masters (Jack Palance) to help them smuggle the shipment off the island and sell it in Hong Kong.

programme.title: Hercules Against Karate
programme.desc: Two martial artists go to Hong Kong to rescue a restaurateur's son from the clutches of an evil kung fu master.

programme.title: Solomon and Sheba
programme.desc: Near death, King David has a vision that his poet son, Solomon (Yul Brynner), should succeed him, rather than hot-headed Adonijah (George Sanders). Furious, Adonijah departs the court, swearing he will become king. Other rulers are concerned that Solomon's benevolent rule and interest in monotheism will threaten their tyrannical, polytheistic kingdoms. The Queen of Sheba (Gina Lollobrigida) makes an agreement with the Egyptian pharaoh (David Farrar) to corrupt Solomon for their mutual benefit.

programme.title: Soldier Boyz
programme.desc: Veteren Howard Toliver (Michael Dudikoff) works at a prison for extremely dangerous juvenile offenders. Recruited to rescue a wealthy girl being held captive in Vietnam, he assembles a team composed of some of the most violent inmates, many of whom are enemies. After battling their way through the jungle, they lay siege to the fortress of the brutal warlord Vinh Moc (Cary-Hiroyuki Tagawa), who has the hostage hidden away. Will they work together, or allow their rivalries to consume them?

programme.title: The Lone Runner
programme.desc: A bounty hunter (Miles O'Keeffe) on horseback rescues a European damsel (Savina Gersak), using only a crossbow and explosive arrows.

programme.title: Wild in the Streets
programme.desc: Archetypal 1960s musician Max Frost (Christopher Jones) lends his backing to a Senate candidate who wants to give 18-year-olds the right to vote, but he takes things a step further than expected. Inspired by their hero's words, Max's fans pressure their leaders into extending the vote to citizens as young as 15. Max and his followers capitalize on their might by bringing new issues to the fore, but, drunk on power, they soon take generational warfare to terrible extremes.

programme.title: Flatbed Annie & Sweetiepie: Lady Truckers
programme.desc: Two women join forces to keep an expensive trucking rig out of the clutches of repossessors and hijackers.

programme.title: Census Taker
programme.desc: Fed up with his intrusiveness, members of a family shoot a census taker and try to hide his body from a detective.

programme.title: The Angel Levine
programme.desc: Unable to work due to a back injury, elderly Jewish tailor Morris Mishkin spends his days caring for his ill wife and wishing for happiness. After Morris sees a man die in the street, the man returns to Morris claiming to be a Jewish angel named Alexander Levine, who must perform a miracle within 24 hours to be confirmed as an angel. As his wife's health improves, Morris shows Alexander that renewing his faith may not be so easy.

programme.title: Salt and Pepper
programme.desc: Christopher Pepper (Peter Lawford) and Charles Salt (Sammy Davis Jr.) are hip Soho nightclub owners enjoying the good life -- until a secret agent turns up dead in their club. They find her diary and, pursuing the case on their own, discover a sinister plot to overthrow the British government, masterminded by a certain Col. Woodstock (John Le Mesurier). Salt and Pepper have a tough time getting anyone to believe their story until Col. Balsom (Ernest Clark) of MI5 hires them to foil the plot.

programme.title: The Wild Pair
programme.desc: An FBI agent (Beau Bridges) and a detective (Bubba Smith) tie ghetto drugs and mayhem to a colonel's (Lloyd Bridges) white supremacists.

programme.title: Carbon Copy
programme.desc: Walter Whitney is a successful executive who resides in an upscale Southern California suburb. Like all of his friends and neighbors, Walter is white, and he is shocked when he learns he has a son he never knew about -- black teen Roger Porter (Denzel Washington). Despite his surprise, Walter welcomes Roger into his home; unfortunately, the less accepting Mrs. Whitney (Susan Saint James) boots both of them out of the house, and Walter's racist boss fires him, leaving him in a tough spot.
